name: Constitution
description: Initialize a new spec-driven development project with the constitution that defines the foundational principles and constraints. This must be the first task in the workflow.
author: Spec Kit Team

inputs.name: projectName
inputs.label: Project Name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name for the spec-driven development project. Defaults to the repository name.

inputs.name: projectPath
inputs.label: Project Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path where the project will be initialized. Defaults to the build sources directory.

inputs.name: constitutionPath
inputs.label: Constitution Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Custom path for the constitution file. If not specified, uses the default .specify/memory/constitution.md path.

inputs.name: aiAssistant
inputs.label: AI Assistant
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select the AI assistant to use for constitution generation.

inputs.name: scriptType
inputs.label: Script Type
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select the script type for the project (PowerShell for Windows, Bash for Linux/macOS).

inputs.name: constitutionVersion
inputs.label: Constitution Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Version of the constitution template to use. Use 'latest' for the most recent version.

inputs.name: updateExisting
inputs.label: Initialize in Current Directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Initialize the project in the current directory instead of creating a new subdirectory.
